name: Real Estate, PropTech & Construction Management Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for Real Estate, PropTech, and Construction Management, covering MLS property listings, tenant lease management, digital rent collection, construction estimation, subcontractor bidding, progress payment certification, and change orders.

checklists.name: Real Estate & Construction Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for property leases, tenant screening, construction estimates, change orders, and progress payments.

items.statement: Tenant lease agreements execute via legally binding e-signatures with security deposit escrow documentation.
Automated rent collection triggers late fee notices for delinquent tenant balances after grace period.
Construction cost estimates incorporate material takeoffs, labor rates, and subcontractor bids.
Change Orders documenting scope modifications receive owner and general contractor signatures before work execution.
AIA G702/G703 progress payment certificates verify verified completion percentages before funds disbursement.

reviewGates.name: Construction & Real Estate Director Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Construction Director and Property Manager confirm that lease contracts, change orders, and progress payments comply with industry standards.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the documentation confirm valid lease execution and certified construction progress billing?
